description: Javni prijevoz Općine Mikleuš is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Općina Mikleuš. Public transport of the Municipality of Mikleuš. Coverage: Općina Mikleuš. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport of the Municipality of Mikleuš" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Općina Mikleuš. Its keywords include javni prijevoz. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, XLSX, PDF, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
